Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you reported
in Conroe, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just give you the details of what happened, if that's okay.
Q: That's fine, but I do need your name on the recording for our file.
A: Understood. It's the policyholder's driver, the person in the vehicle at the time.
Q: Thank you. Can you describe where you were when the collision occurred?
A: I was driving on a two-lane road heading toward a shopping area. It was a clear afternoon and traffic was
moderate.
Q: What happened just before the impact?
A: The other car drifted into my lane around a curve. I braked and steered to the right, but we still made contact nearly
head on. It wasn't a hard hit, more of a jolt.
Q: What was your speed at the time?
A: Probably around 20 or 25 miles per hour. I wasn't going fast.
Q: Did either airbag deploy?
A: No, they did not.
Q: Did you go to a medical facility after the collision?
A: Yes, I was checked out the same day. My neck felt stiff and sore, and the doctor diagnosed a neck strain. I've been
doing physical therapy since then.
Q: Have you had any prior neck or back complaints?
A: No, nothing serious. I had some stiffness years ago after lifting something, but it resolved on its own.
Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I'm still having headaches and some trouble turnnig my head to the left. I'd like to keep my records
updated for you.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
</page>

injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
